en: Sepia-tone postcard showing the interior of an entertainment hall with ornate columns, hanging lamps, wicker seating around tables, a piano, framed paintings, and decorative busts. Caption on the front reads 'Unterhaltungssaal' and 'Richters Pension, Bad Pyrmont'. The back is a divided postcard with a museum stamp reading 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT' and some penciled catalog numbers.
